features: MULTIFUNCTIONAL CABLE CONVERTER KIT: All-in-one accessory kit designed to support multiple charging and connectivity needs with multi-type charging adapters, making it convenient for smartphones, tablets and other compatible gadgets.

USB TYPE-C ADAPTER & MULTI-TYPE COMPATIBILITY: Includes a USB Type-C converter to improve compatibility with modern smartphones and electronic devices, offering a practical solution for everyday charging and data connectivity requirements.

PORTABLE STORAGE & ORGANIZER BOX: Compact storage case keeps adapters, SIM cards, eject pin and other small accessories neatly organized in one place, making the kit ideal for travel, office, home and daily use.

BUILT-IN PHONE STAND FOR HANDS-FREE USE: The multifunctional storage box doubles as a convenient mobile phone holder, allowing hands-free viewing while watching videos, making calls or following content on your smartphone.

SIM CARD HOLDER WITH EJECT PIN: Dedicated SIM card storage helps you safely carry spare SIM cards, while the included SIM tray ejector pin makes SIM swapping and removal quick and convenient whenever required.
description: Keep your essential mobile accessories organized with this multifunctional data cable converter kit. Designed for modern smartphones and gadgets, it combines multi-type charging adapters, a USB Type-C converter, SIM card storage, a SIM tray eject pin, and a built-in mobile phone stand in one compact and portable storage box. The USB Type-C adapter helps provide compatibility with compatible modern devices, while the multi-type charging line makes everyday charging and connectivity more convenient. The dedicated SIM card slot allows you to carry spare SIM cards securely, and the included eject pin makes SIM tray removal quick and easy. The compact organizer box keeps your small accessories neatly stored and easy to carry. It can also be used as a convenient phone holder for hands-free viewing. Ideal for home, office, travel, business trips and everyday use, this multifunctional accessory kit is a practical companion for smartphone and gadget users.
